Theory Equational_Narrowing

(*
Author:  Dohan Kim <dohan.kim@uibk.ac.at> (2024)
License: LGPL (see file COPYING.LESSER)

section ‹Formalization of equational narrowing and lifting lemma›

theory Equational_Narrowing
  imports
    Narrowing
begin

(* First, consider the unconditional narrowing *)
(* An equation s ≈ t is converted into the equation-term ≐(s, t). 
  Also, the rewrite rule "≐(x, x) ⟶ ⊤" is added to the rewrite system. *)

(*  Acknowledgement: Defining the following locale is done by René Thiemann *)
locale additional_narrowing_symbols =
  fixes DOTEQ :: 'f ("≐")
  and TOP :: "'f" ("⊤")
begin
definition wf_equational_term where
  "wf_equational_term t ⟷ ((t = Fun ⊤ []) ∨ (∃u v. t = Fun ≐ [u::('f, 'v)term, v::('f, 'v)term] ∧ 
    (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term u ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term v ∧ (⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term u ∧ (⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term v))"

definition wf_equational_term_mset::"('f, 'v::infinite) term multiset ⇒ bool" where
  "wf_equational_term_mset M ⟷ (∀t ∈# M. wf_equational_term t)"
end

locale equational_narrowing = narrowing R + additional_narrowing_symbols DOTEQ TOP 
  for R::"('f, 'v:: infinite) trs"  
    and DOTEQ :: 'f ("≐")
    and TOP :: "'f" ("⊤") +
  fixes R' :: "('f, 'v:: infinite) trs"
    and F :: "'f sig"
    and D :: "'f sig"
    and x :: 'v
  assumes  wf: "wf_trs R" (* Add the rewrite rule  x ≐ x ⟶ ⊤ *)
    and R':"R = (R' ∪ {(Fun ≐ [Var x, Var x], Fun ⊤ [])})"
    and R_sig: "funas_trs R' ⊆ F"
    and D:"D = {(≐, 2),(⊤, 0)}" 
    (* The special symbols (≐, 2) and (⊤, 0) should be distinct from the original signature *)
    and D_fresh:"D ∩ F = {}"
    (* Any substitution does not introduce the special symbols ≐ and ⊤ *)
    and wf_eq_subst:"∀(θ::('f, 'v:: infinite)subst) t::('f, 'v:: infinite)term. wf_equational_term t ⟶ wf_equational_term (t ⋅ θ)"
    and wf_F_subst:"∀t (θ::('f, 'v)subst). funas_term t ⊆ F ⟷ funas_term (t ⋅ θ) ⊆ F"
    (* Any substitution has a finite substitution domain because only finite terms are considered.*)
    and finite_subst_domain:"∀s (θ::('f, 'v)subst). (finite (vars_term (s ⋅ θ)) ⟶ (finite (vars_term s) ∧ finite (subst_domain θ)))"    
begin

definition "narrowing_derivation_reaches_to_success eq ⟷ (∃σ. narrowing_derivation (Fun ≐ [fst eq, snd eq]) (Fun ⊤ []) σ)"

(* E is represented by R *)

definition "E_unifiable eq ⟷ (∃τ. ((fst eq) ⋅ τ, (snd eq) ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*)"
definition "R_unifiable C ⟷ (∃τ. (∀u v. (u, v) ∈ set C ⟶ (u ⋅ τ, v ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*))"


definition "reachable eq ⟷ (∃τ. ((fst eq) ⋅ τ, (snd eq) ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*)"
definition "infeasible eq ⟷ (¬ (∃τ. ((fst eq) ⋅ τ, (snd eq) ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*))"
definition "reachability C ⟷ (∃τ. (∀u v. (u, v) ∈ set C ⟶ (u ⋅ τ, v ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*))"
definition "infeasibility C ⟷ (¬ (∃τ. (∀u v. (u, v) ∈ set C ⟶ (u ⋅ τ, v ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*)))"


definition "normalizable_infeasibility eq ⟷ (¬ (∃τ. ((fst eq) ⋅ τ, (snd eq) ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧* ∧ normalizable_subst R τ))"

definition "normalizable_reachability_property s t ⟷ (∀τ. (s ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧* ⟶ normalizable_subst R τ)"

definition "normalized_subst_reachability_property s t ⟷ (∀τ. ∃τ'. (s ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧* ⟶ 
    (normal_subst R τ' ∧ (s ⋅ τ', t ⋅ τ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧* ∧ (∀x. (τ x, τ' x) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*)))"

definition "E_unif_normalized_subst_reachability_property s t ⟷ (∀τ. ∃τ'. (s ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧* ⟶ 
    (normal_subst R τ' ∧ (s ⋅ τ', t ⋅ τ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧* ∧ (∀x. (τ x, τ' x) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*)))"

definition subst_modulo :: "('f, 'v) subst ⇒ ('f, 'v) subst ⇒ bool" (infix "=⇩R" 55) 
  where "σ =⇩R θ = (∀x. (σ x, θ x) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*)"

lemma root_special_notin_F: assumes "root t = Some (≐, 2) ∨ root t = Some (⊤, 0)"
  shows "¬ funas_term t ⊆ F" using root_symbol_in_funas D assms D_fresh 
  by (auto simp add: root_symbol_in_funas subset_iff, fastforce+) 

lemma root_not_special_symbols: assumes "(l, r) ∈ R'"
  and "funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F"
  and rnone:"root l ≠ None"
shows "root l ≠ Some (≐, 2) ∧ root l ≠ Some (⊤, 0)" 
  using assms root_special_notin_F unfolding funas_rule_def D D_fresh R_sig 
    funas_rule_def funas_trs_def by auto

lemma wf_equational_term_safe_replace: assumes wf_s:"wf_equational_term s"
  and ft:"funas_term t ⊆ F"
  and pn:"p ≠ []"
  and pfun:"p ∈ fun_poss s"
  and snF:"s ≠ Fun (⊤) []"
shows "wf_equational_term (replace_at s p t)" 
proof -
  from wf_s[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] snF
  have "(∃u v. s = Fun ≐ [u, v] ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term u ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term v)" by auto
  then obtain u v where s:"s = Fun ≐ [u, v]" and nu:"(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term u" and nv:"(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term v" by auto
  have poss_us:"∀q ∈ poss u. u |_ q = s |_ (0 # q)" using s by auto  
  have poss_vs:"∀q' ∈ poss v. v |_ q' = s |_ (1 # q')" using s by auto
  have "∃q r. (q ∈ poss u ∧ p = 0 # q) ∨ (r ∈ poss v ∧ p = 1 # r)" using s pn pfun 
  proof(auto, goal_cases)
    case (1 x p)
    then show ?case by (metis fun_poss_imp_poss length_nth_simps(3) less_2_cases nth_Cons_Suc numeral_2_eq_2)
  next
    case (2 x p)
    then show ?case by (metis fun_poss_imp_poss less_2_cases nth_Cons_0 nth_Cons_Suc numeral_2_eq_2)
  next
    case (3 x p)
    then show ?case by (metis fun_poss_imp_poss less_2_cases nth_Cons_0 numeral_2_eq_2)
  qed
  then obtain q r where qpos:"(q ∈ poss u ∧ p = 0 # q) ∨ (r ∈ poss v ∧ p = 1 # r)" (is "?A ∨ ?B") by auto
  then show ?thesis
  proof
    assume asm:?A
    hence "replace_at s p t = Fun ≐ [(replace_at u q t), v]"  using s by auto
    moreover have "(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term (replace_at u q t)" using D D_fresh qpos ft nu 
      by (smt (verit) UnCI UnE asm ctxt_supt_id funas_term_ctxt_apply insert_disjoint(1) subset_iff)
    moreover have "(⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term (replace_at u q t)" using D D_fresh qpos ft nu
      by (metis (no_types, lifting) UnCI UnE  wf_s[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] asm ctxt_supt_id 
          funas_term_ctxt_apply insert_disjoint(1) list.inject s snF subset_iff term.inject(2))
    then show ?thesis using assms s nv unfolding wf_s[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] 
      using calculation wf_equational_term_def by (simp add: wf_equational_term_def)
  next
    assume asm:?B
    hence "replace_at s p t = Fun ≐ [u , (replace_at v r t)]" using s by auto
    moreover have "(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term (replace_at v r t)" using D D_fresh qpos ft nv  
      by (smt (verit) UnCI UnE asm ctxt_supt_id funas_term_ctxt_apply insert_disjoint(1) subset_iff)
    moreover have "(⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term (replace_at v r t)" using D D_fresh qpos ft nu
      by (metis (no_types, lifting) UnCI UnE  wf_s[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] asm ctxt_supt_id 
          funas_term_ctxt_apply insert_disjoint(1) list.inject s snF subset_iff term.inject(2))
    then show ?thesis using assms s nu unfolding wf_s[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] 
      using calculation wf_equational_term_def by (simp add: wf_equational_term_def)
  qed
qed

lemma convert_equation_into_term_sound: fixes rl::"('f, 'v) rule"
  assumes "funas_rule rl ⊆ F"
  shows "wf_equational_term (Fun (≐) [fst rl, snd rl])" 
proof -
  have *:"(≐, 2) ∉ funas_rule rl ∧ (⊤, 0) ∉ funas_rule rl"
    using D D_fresh assms by blast
  let ?C = "Fun (≐) [fst rl, snd rl]"
  have "(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term (fst rl) ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term (snd rl)" using * lhs_wf rhs_wf 
    by (simp add: funas_defs(2))
  moreover have "(⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term (fst rl) ∧ (⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term (snd rl)" using * lhs_wf rhs_wf 
    by (simp add: funas_defs(2))
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: wf_equational_term_def wf_equational_term_mset_def, insert calculation, auto)
qed

lemma WN_obtains_normalizable_subst: fixes σ::"('f, 'v)subst"
  assumes "WN (rstep R)"
  obtains "normalizable_subst R σ" using assms unfolding normalizable_subst_def WN_on_def
  by (auto, meson normalizability_E)

lemma SN_obtains_normalizable_subst: fixes σ::"('f, 'v)subst"
  assumes "SN (rstep R)"
  obtains "normalizable_subst R σ" using assms unfolding normalizable_subst_def SN_on_def
    by (meson SN_imp_WN assms equational_narrowing.WN_obtains_normalizable_subst equational_narrowing_axioms that)

lemma obtains_normalized_subst: 
  assumes "normalizable_subst R σ"
  obtains τ where "normal_subst R τ" and "(∀x. (σ x, τ x) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*)"
proof -
  let ?F = "λx y. (σ x, y) ∈ (rstep R)⇧* ∧ y ∈ NF (rstep R)"
  from assms[unfolded normalizable_subst_def] have "∀x ∈ subst_domain σ. ∃y. ?F x y" by auto
  from bchoice[OF this] 
  obtain τ' where *:"∀x ∈ subst_domain σ.  (σ x, τ' x) ∈ (rstep R)⇧* ∧ τ' x ∈ NF (rstep R)" by auto
  define τ where "τ ≡ τ' |s (subst_domain σ)"
  have "subst_domain τ ⊆ subst_domain σ" unfolding τ_def by auto
      (metis Int_iff restrict_subst subst_domain_restrict_subst_domain)
  hence "normal_subst R τ ∧ (∀x. (σ x, τ x) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*)" unfolding some_NF_def normal_subst_def τ_def
    using * by auto 
      (metis in_subst_restrict notin_subst_domain_imp_Var notin_subst_restrict rtrancl.simps)
  then show ?thesis using that by auto
qed

lemma funas_preserve_rstep: assumes fun_u:"funas_term u ⊆ F"
  and uv:"(u, v) ∈ (rstep R')⇧*"
shows "funas_term v ⊆ F" using uv 
proof (induct, insert fun_u)
  case base
  then show ?case by (simp add: assms(1))
next
  case (step s t)
  from ‹(s, t) ∈ rstep R'›
  obtain C σ l r where "(l, r) ∈ R'" and "s = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and "t = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
  then show ?case using R_sig R' step unfolding funas_defs by auto 
      (meson R_sig rhs_wf subsetD wf_F_subst)  
qed

lemma funas_reverse_preserve_rstep: assumes fun_v:"funas_term v ⊆ F"
  and uv:"(u, v) ∈ (rstep R')⇧*"
shows "funas_term u ⊆ F" using uv
proof -
  from uv obtain n where "(u, v) ∈ (rstep R')^^n" by auto
  then show ?thesis
  proof (induct n arbitrary: u)
    case 0
    then show ?case using fun_v by auto 
  next
    case (Suc n)
    from Suc (2) obtain w where uw:"(u, w) ∈ rstep R'" and wv:"(w, v) ∈ (rstep R')^^ n"
      by (meson relpow_Suc_D2)
    from Suc(1) have fw:"funas_term w ⊆ F" using wv by auto
    from uw obtain C σ l r where "(l, r) ∈ R'" and "u = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and "w = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
    then show ?case using R_sig R' step unfolding funas_defs using fw 
      by (auto, smt (verit) R_sig lhs_wf subsetD wf_F_subst)
  qed
qed

lemma funas_term_restrict: "funas_term s ⊆ F ⟹ (s, t) ∈ rstep R ⟹ (s, t) ∈ rstep R'"
proof -
  assume funas_s:"funas_term s ⊆ F"
    and st:"(s, t) ∈ rstep R"
  from st obtain C σ l r where lr:"(l, r) ∈ R"  and s:"s = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and t:"t = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
  let ?srule = "λx. (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])"
  have fr:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" using D 
    unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
  have cd:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) ⊆ D" using D 
    unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
  have rule_type:"(l, r) ∈ R' ∨ (∃x. (l, r) = ?srule x)" using R' lr by fastforce
  hence frule_type:"funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F ∨ (∃x. (l, r) = ?srule x)" using R_sig 
    by (metis fst_conv funas_rule_def le_supI lhs_wf rhs_wf snd_conv)
  have fnlr:"funas_rule (l, r) ≠ {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}"
  proof(rule ccontr)
    assume "¬ ?thesis"
    hence flr:"funas_rule (l, r) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" by auto
    hence "funas_rule (l, r) = D" using D by auto
    have *:"∃x. l = (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x])" and "r = Fun (⊤) []"
      using R' lr R_sig D D_fresh flr frule_type unfolding funas_defs by force+
    hence fl:"funas_term l = {(≐, 2)}" by auto
    obtain x where l:"l = (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x])" using "*" by auto
    have lσs:"l ⋅ σ ⊴ s" using s by simp
    hence "l ⊴ s" using l wf_F_subst R_sig D D_fresh by auto 
        (metis lσs fl funas_s insert_subset subset_trans supteq_imp_funas_term_subset)
    hence "funas_term l ⊆ F" using funas_s
      by (meson subset_trans supteq_imp_funas_term_subset)
    then show False using fl D D_fresh by auto
  qed 
  hence **:"funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F" using fr by (metis frule_type)
  then show ?thesis
  proof -
    have "funas_rule (l, r) ≠ {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" unfolding funas_defs using ** R' R_sig D D_fresh  wf_F_subst 
      by (metis fnlr funas_rule_def)
    then show ?thesis using R' R_sig D D_fresh  wf_F_subst 
      by (metis fr rstepI rule_type s t)
  qed
qed

lemma funas_term_reverse_restrict: "funas_term t ⊆ F ⟹ (s, t) ∈ rstep R ⟹ (s, t) ∈ rstep R'" 
proof -
  assume funas_t:"funas_term t ⊆ F"
    and st:"(s, t) ∈ rstep R"
  from st obtain C σ l r where lr:"(l, r) ∈ R"  and s:"s = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and t:"t = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
  let ?srule = "λx. (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])"
  have fr:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" using D 
    unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
  have cd:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) ⊆ D" using D 
    unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
  have rule_type:"(l, r) ∈ R' ∨ (∃x. (l, r) = ?srule x)" using R' lr by fastforce
  hence frule_type:"funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F ∨ (∃x. (l, r) = ?srule x)" using R_sig 
    by (metis fst_conv funas_rule_def le_supI lhs_wf rhs_wf snd_conv)
  have fnlr:"funas_rule (l, r) ≠ {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}"
  proof(rule ccontr)
    assume asm:"¬ ?thesis"
    hence flr:"funas_rule (l, r) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" by auto
    hence flr:"funas_rule (l, r) = D" using D by auto
    have *:"∃x. l = (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x])" and "r = Fun (⊤) []"
      using R' lr R_sig D D_fresh flr frule_type unfolding funas_defs by force+
    hence fl:"funas_term l = {(≐, 2)}" by auto
    obtain x where l:"l = (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x])" using "*" by auto
    have lσs:"l ⋅ σ ⊴ s" using s by simp
    hence "l ⊴ s" using l wf_F_subst R_sig D D_fresh flr funas_t t unfolding funas_defs  by auto
    hence "funas_term l ⊆ F" using funas_t asm D D_fresh fl unfolding funas_defs
      by (metis (no_types, lifting) Int_absorb2 fst_conv funas_term_ctxt_apply insertCI insert_absorb 
          insert_disjoint(1) insert_is_Un le_sup_iff singleton_insert_inj_eq snd_conv t wf_F_subst zero_neq_numeral)
    then show False using fl D D_fresh by auto
  qed 
  hence **:"funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F" using fr by (metis frule_type)
  then show ?thesis
  proof -
    have "funas_rule (l, r) ≠ {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" unfolding funas_defs using ** R' R_sig D D_fresh  wf_F_subst 
      by (metis fnlr funas_rule_def)
    then show ?thesis using R' R_sig D D_fresh  wf_F_subst 
      by (metis fr rstepI rule_type s t)
  qed
qed

lemma funas_rstep_R':assumes funas_uv:"funas_rule (u, v) ⊆ F"
  and uv:"(u, v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" 
shows "(u, v) ∈ (rstep R')⇧*" using uv
proof (induct)
  case base
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (step s t)
  from funas_uv have funas_u:"funas_term u ⊆ F" by (simp add: funas_rule_def)
  from ‹(u, s) ∈ (rstep R')⇧*›
  have funas_s:"funas_term s ⊆ F"
    by (simp add:funas_preserve_rstep[OF funas_u ‹(u, s) ∈ (rstep R')⇧*›])
  from funas_term_restrict[OF funas_s ‹(s, t) ∈ rstep R›]
  have "(s, t) ∈ rstep R'" by auto
  then show ?case using step by auto
qed

lemma funas_rstep_R'_conv:assumes funas_uv:"funas_rule (u, v) ⊆ F"
  and uv:"(u, v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*" 
shows "(u, v) ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔⇧*"
proof -
  from uv obtain n where "(u, v) ∈ ((rstep R)⇧↔)^^n" by auto
  then show ?thesis using funas_uv
  proof(induct n arbitrary: v)
    case 0
    then show ?case by auto
  next
    case (Suc n)
    from Suc(2) obtain w where uwn:"(u, w) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔ ^^ n" and wv:"(w, v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔" by auto
    from Suc(3) have fuF:"funas_term u ⊆ F" unfolding funas_defs by auto
    from uwn have fuwF:"funas_rule (u, w) ⊆ F"
    proof(induct n arbitrary: w)
      case 0
      then show ?case using fuF funas_term_restrict unfolding funas_defs by auto
    next
      case (Suc n)
      from Suc(2) obtain v where "(u, v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔ ^^ n" and vw:"(v, w) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔" by auto
      hence "funas_rule (u, v) ⊆ F" using Suc(1) by auto
      hence fvF:"funas_term v ⊆ F" unfolding funas_defs by auto
      from vw have "(v, w) ∈ (rstep R) ∨ (w, v) ∈ (rstep R)" by auto
      then show ?case (*using fuF funas_term_restrict funas_reverse_preserve_rstep unfolding funas_defs apply auto*)
      proof
        assume "(v, w) ∈ (rstep R)"
        with fvF have "funas_term w ⊆ F" using funas_preserve_rstep funas_term_restrict r_into_rtrancl by blast
        then show ?thesis unfolding funas_defs using fuF by simp
      next
        assume "(w, v) ∈ (rstep R)"
        with fvF have "funas_term w ⊆ F" using funas_reverse_preserve_rstep funas_term_reverse_restrict 
            r_into_rtrancl r_into_rtrancl by blast
        then show ?thesis unfolding funas_defs using fuF by simp
      qed
    qed
    from Suc(1) have *:"(u, w) ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔⇧*" using uwn fuwF by auto
    have fwF:"funas_term w ⊆ F" using fuF 
      by (auto, metis UnI2 funas_defs(2) fuwF in_mono snd_eqD)
    from wv have "(w, v) ∈ (rstep R) ∨ (v, w) ∈ (rstep R)" by auto
    then show ?case
    proof
      assume "(w, v) ∈ (rstep R)"
      then show ?thesis using fuF fwF *
        by (meson conversionI' conversion_trans funas_term_restrict narrowing_axioms r_into_rtrancl transD)
    next
      assume "(v, w) ∈ (rstep R)"
      then show ?thesis using fuF fwF * Suc(3) by (metis (no_types, lifting) conversionI' conversion_inv 
            conversion_trans funas_defs(2) le_supE funas_term_restrict r_into_rtrancl snd_eqD transD)
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma rstep_reduction_step_eq: assumes uv:"((u, v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*)"
  shows "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ⊤ []) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*"
proof -
  from rsteps_closed_ctxt[OF uv, of "More ≐ [] Hole [v]"]
  have "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ≐ [v, v]) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" by auto
  moreover have "(Fun ≐ [v, v], Fun ⊤ []) ∈ rstep R" 
    by (intro rstepI[where C = Hole and σ = "λ _. v"], unfold R', auto)
  ultimately show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma not_reducible_T:"¬ (∃t. (Fun (⊤) [], t) ∈ (rstep R))"
proof(rule ccontr)
  assume "¬ ?thesis"
  then obtain t where *:"(Fun (⊤) [], t) ∈ (rstep R)" by auto
  have "¬ funas_term (Fun (⊤) []) ⊆ F" using D D_fresh R_sig by auto
  hence "(Fun (⊤) [], t) ∉ (rstep R')" using R_sig by (smt (verit) lhs_wf rrstep_imp_rule_subst 
        rstep_args_NF_imp_rrstep supt_const wf_F_subst) 
  hence "∃x. (Fun (⊤) [], t) ∈ (rstep {((Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) []))})" using * R' 
    by (metis R' Un_iff rstep_union)
  then obtain x where "(Fun (⊤) [], t) ∈ (rstep {((Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) []))})" by auto
  then obtain C σ l r where l:"l = Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x]" and r:"r = Fun (⊤) []" and eq:"Fun (⊤) [] = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩"
    and t:"t = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by (smt (verit) Pair_inject rstep.simps singletonD)
  from t eq have "C = Hole" by (metis nectxt_imp_supt_ctxt supt_const)
  then show False using eq l by auto
qed

lemma rstep_reduction_step_R_unif_eq: assumes funas_uv:"funas_rule (u, v) ⊆ F"
  and uv:"((u, v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*)"
  and cr:"CR (rstep R)"
shows "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ⊤ []) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using assms
proof -
  from funas_rstep_R'_conv[OF funas_uv uv]
  have uvR':"(u, v) ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔⇧*" by auto
  then obtain n where "(u, v) ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔^^n" by auto
  then show ?thesis using funas_uv
  proof (induct n arbitrary:u v)
    case 0
    have "∃x. (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) []) ∈ R" using R' by auto
    then obtain x::'v where rl:"(Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) []) ∈ R" by auto
    have "is_Fun (Fun ≐ [v, v])" by auto
    let ?p = "[]::pos"
    let ?s = "Fun ≐ [v, v]"
    let ?σ = "Var (x := v)" 
    let ?rl = "(Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])"
    let ?C = "Hole"
    let ?t = "Fun (⊤) []"
    have "u = v" using 0 by auto
    have *:"snd ?rl ⋅ ?σ = Fun (⊤) []" by auto
    then show ?case using rl rstep.intros[of "fst ?rl" "snd ?rl" R ?s ?C ?σ ?t] using 0(1) by force
  next
    case (Suc n)
    note ** = this
    have fuv:"funas_rule (u, v) ⊆ F" using Suc(3) by auto
    from ‹(u, v) ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔ ^^ Suc n›
    obtain w where uw:"(u, w) ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔ ^^ n" and wv:"(w, v) ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔" by auto
    from uw have "funas_rule (u, w) ⊆ F"
    proof(induct n arbitrary:w)
      case 0
      have "funas_term u ⊆ F" unfolding funas_defs using **(3) 
        using funas_rule_def by fastforce
      then show ?case  unfolding funas_defs using 0 by auto
    next
      case (Suc n)
      from Suc(2) obtain w' where uw':"(u, w') ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔ ^^ n" and w'w:"(w', w) ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔" by auto
      from Suc(1) have fuw':"funas_rule (u, w') ⊆ F" using uw' by auto
      from w'w have *:"(w', w) ∈ (rstep R') ∨ (w, w') ∈ (rstep R')" by auto
      show ?case using *
      proof
        assume "(w', w) ∈ (rstep R')"
        then show ?thesis unfolding funas_defs using fuw' funas_preserve_rstep
          by (metis Un_subset_iff fst_conv funas_rule_def r_into_rtrancl snd_conv) 
      next
        assume "(w, w') ∈ (rstep R')"
        with fuw' have "funas_term w ⊆ F" unfolding funas_defs using funas_reverse_preserve_rstep by auto
        moreover from fuw' have "funas_term u ⊆ F" unfolding funas_defs by auto
        ultimately show ?thesis unfolding funas_defs by auto
      qed 
    qed
    hence *:"(Fun ≐ [u, w], Fun ⊤ []) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using Suc(1) uw by auto
    from wv have "(w, v) ∈ (rstep R') ∨ (v, w) ∈ (rstep R')" by auto
    then show ?case 
    proof
      assume "(w, v) ∈ (rstep R')"
      hence wv:"(w, v) ∈ rstep R" using R' by blast
      hence "(Fun ≐ [u, w], Fun ≐ [u, v]) ∈ (rstep R)" 
      proof -
        from wv obtain C σ l r where lr:"(l, r) ∈ R" and w:"w = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and v:"v = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
        let ?p = "1 # hole_pos C"
        let ?w = "Fun ≐ [u, w]"
        let ?v = "Fun ≐ [u, v]"
        let ?C = "ctxt_of_pos_term ?p ?w"
        have "?w = ?C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" using w by auto
        moreover have "?v = ?C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" using w v wv by auto 
        ultimately have "(Fun ≐ [u, w], Fun ≐ [u, v]) ∈ rstep R" using lr by blast
        then show ?thesis by auto
      qed
      then show ?thesis using * cr[unfolded CR_on_def] 
        by (meson CR_divergence_imp_join NF_I NF_join_imp_reach cr not_reducible_T r_into_rtrancl)
    next
      assume vw:"(v, w) ∈ (rstep R')"
      hence vw:"(v, w) ∈ rstep R" using R' by blast
      hence "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ≐ [u, w]) ∈ (rstep R)"
      proof -
        from vw obtain C σ l r where lr:"(l, r) ∈ R" and v:"v = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and w:"w = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
        let ?p = "1 # hole_pos C"
        let ?v = "Fun ≐ [u, v]"
        let ?w = "Fun ≐ [u, w]"
        let ?C = "ctxt_of_pos_term ?p ?v"
        have "?v = ?C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" using v by auto
        moreover have "?w = ?C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" using w v wv by auto 
        ultimately have "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ≐ [u, w]) ∈ rstep R" using lr by blast
        then show ?thesis by auto
      qed
      then show ?thesis by (simp add: "*" converse_rtrancl_into_rtrancl)
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma rstep_reduction_R_unif_normalized_equiv: assumes funas_st:"funas_rule (s, t) ⊆ F"
  and "∃τ. (s ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧* ∧ normal_subst R τ"
  and cr:"CR (rstep R)"
shows "∃θ. normal_subst R θ ∧ (Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ, t ⋅ θ], Fun (⊤) []) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*"
proof -
  from assms obtain τ where st:"(s ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*" and normτ:"normal_subst R τ" by auto
  have *:"funas_rule (s ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ) ⊆ F" using funas_st wf_F_subst unfolding funas_defs by auto
  from rstep_reduction_step_R_unif_eq[of "s ⋅ τ" "t ⋅ τ"]
  show ?thesis using * normτ st cr by auto
qed

lemma rstep_reduction_equiv: assumes wn:"WN (rstep R)"
  and cr: "CR (rstep R)"
  and sti:"strongly_irreducible_term R t"
  and funas_st:"funas_rule (s, t) ⊆ F"
  and rstep_st:"∃τ. (s ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*"
shows "∃θ. normal_subst R θ ∧ (Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ, t ⋅ θ], Fun (⊤) []) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*"
proof -
  from rstep_st obtain τ where stτ:"(s ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" by auto
  from WN_obtains_normalizable_subst[OF wn]
  have normτ:"normalizable_subst R τ" by auto
  from obtains_normalized_subst[OF normτ]
  obtain τ' where normτ':"normal_subst R τ'" and ττ':"(∀x. (τ x, τ' x) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*)" by auto
  have rstepτ':"(s ⋅ τ', t ⋅ τ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧*"
  proof -
    have "(s ⋅ τ, s ⋅ τ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using ττ' 
      by (simp add: substs_rsteps)
    moreover have "(t ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using ττ'  
      by (simp add: substs_rsteps)
    moreover have "t ⋅ τ' ∈ NF (rstep R)" using sti[unfolded strongly_irreducible_term_def] normτ' by auto
    moreover have "(s ⋅ τ', t ⋅ τ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*" 
      by (meson calculation(1) calculation(2) in_mono meetI meet_imp_conversion rtrancl_trans stτ)
    ultimately show "(s ⋅ τ', t ⋅ τ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using cr[unfolded CR_on_def] 
      by (meson CR_NF_conv cr normalizability_E)
  qed
  have frτ':"funas_rule (s ⋅ τ', t ⋅ τ') ⊆ F" using wf_F_subst unfolding funas_defs 
    by (metis Un_subset_iff fst_conv funas_st funas_rule_def snd_conv)
  have tτ':"t ⋅ τ' ∈ NF (rstep R)" using normτ' sti 
    by (simp add: strongly_irreducible_term_def)
  show ?thesis
  proof(rule exI[of _ τ'], intro conjI)
    show "normal_subst R τ'" by (simp add: normτ')
    from rstep_reduction_step_eq[of "s ⋅ τ'" "t ⋅ τ'"]
    show "(Fun ≐ [s ⋅ τ', t ⋅ τ'], Fun ⊤ []) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using frτ' rstepτ' tτ' by auto
  qed
qed

lemma rstep_reduction_normalizable_equiv: assumes cr: "CR (rstep R)"
  and rstep_st:"∃τ. (s ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧* ∧ normalizable_subst R τ"
shows "∃θ. normal_subst R θ ∧ (Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ, t ⋅ θ], Fun (⊤) []) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*"
proof -
  from rstep_st obtain τ where stτ:"(s ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" and normτ:"normalizable_subst R τ" by auto
  from obtains_normalized_subst[OF normτ]
  obtain τ' where normτ':"normal_subst R τ'" and ττ':"(∀x. (τ x, τ' x) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*)" by auto
  have rstepτ':"(s ⋅ τ', t ⋅ τ') ∈ join (rstep R)"
  proof -
    have "(s ⋅ τ, s ⋅ τ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using ττ' 
      by (simp add: substs_rsteps)
    moreover have "(t ⋅ τ, t ⋅ τ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using ττ'  
      by (simp add: substs_rsteps)
    ultimately show "(s ⋅ τ', t ⋅ τ') ∈ join (rstep R)" using stτ 
      by (metis CR_divergence_imp_join CR_join_right_I cr)
  qed
  then obtain u where su: "(s ⋅ τ', u) ∈ (rstep R)^*" and tu: "(t ⋅ τ', u) ∈ (rstep R)^*" by auto  
  have all: "all_ctxt_closed UNIV ((rstep R)^*)" by blast
  have "(Fun ≐ [s ⋅ τ', t ⋅ τ'], Fun ≐ [u, u]) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" 
    by (rule all_ctxt_closedD[OF all], insert su tu, auto simp: less_Suc_eq)
  moreover have "(Fun ≐ [u, u], Fun (⊤) []) ∈ rstep R" unfolding R'
    by (intro rstepI[of _ _ _ _ Hole "λ _. u"], auto)
  ultimately show ?thesis
    by (intro exI[of _ τ'], insert normτ', auto)
qed


lemma F_term_not_reachable_by_additional_rule: fixes u::"('f, 'v) term"
  assumes funas_u:"funas_term u ⊆ F"
  shows "¬ (∃t. (u, t) ∈ rstep {(Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])})" 
proof(rule ccontr)
  assume "¬ ?thesis"
  then obtain t where ut:"(u, t) ∈ rstep {(Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])}" by auto
  hence "(u, t) ∈ rstep R" using R' by blast
  hence "(u, t) ∈ rstep R'" using funas_rstep_R' funas_u 
    using funas_term_restrict by auto
  then obtain C σ l r where lrR':"(l, r) ∈ R'" and u:"u = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and t:"t = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
  from funas_u u have "funas_ctxt C ⊆ F" by auto
  hence funas_t:"funas_term t ⊆ F" using t by auto
      (meson R_sig lrR' rhs_wf subsetD wf_F_subst)
  from ut obtain C' σ' l' r' where lrR':"(l', r') ∈ {(Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])}" and 
    u:"u = C'⟨l' ⋅ σ'⟩" and t:"t = C'⟨r' ⋅ σ'⟩" by auto
  hence "t = C'⟨Fun (⊤) []⟩" by auto
  then show False using funas_t D D_fresh by auto 
qed

lemma obtain_hole_pos_fun_uv:assumes fuv:"Fun ≐ [u, v] = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩"
  and lr:"(l, r) ∈ R'"
  and nC:"C ≠ Hole"
obtains q w where "(q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q) ∨ (w ∈ poss v ∧ hole_pos C = 1 # w)"
proof -
  have hcne:"hole_pos C ≠ []" using nC 
    by (metis ctxt_of_pos_term.simps(1) ctxt_of_pos_term_hole_pos)
  have "is_Fun l" using wf[unfolded wf_trs_def] lr R' by auto
  hence "is_Fun (l ⋅ σ)" by auto
  moreover have *:"hole_pos C ∈ poss C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" by simp
  moreover have **:"is_Fun (C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ |_ (hole_pos C))" 
    by (simp add: calculation(1))
  from poss_is_Fun_fun_poss[OF * **]
  have hcfun:"hole_pos C ∈ fun_poss C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
  have poss_us:"∀q ∈ poss u. u |_ q = Fun ≐ [u, v] |_ (0 # q)" by auto  
  have poss_vs:"∀q' ∈ poss v. v |_ q' = Fun ≐ [u, v] |_ (1 # q')"  by auto
  have "∃q r. (q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q) ∨ (r ∈ poss v ∧ hole_pos C = 1 # r)" using fuv nC hcne hcfun 
  proof(auto, goal_cases)
    case (1 x p)
    then show ?case 
      by (metis fun_poss_imp_poss length_nth_simps(3) less_Suc0 less_SucE nth_Cons_Suc)
  next
    case (2 x p)
    then show ?case 
      by (metis diff_Suc_1 fun_poss_imp_poss less_Suc0 less_SucE nth_Cons')
  next
    case (3 x p)
    then show ?case
      by (metis fun_poss_imp_poss length_nth_simps(3) less_Suc0 less_SucE)
  qed  
  then show ?thesis using that by auto
qed

lemma obtain_hole_pos_fun_uv_right_irreducible:assumes fuv:"Fun ≐ [u, v] = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩"
  and lr:"(l, r) ∈ R'"
  and nC:"C ≠ Hole"
  and vNF:"v ∈ NF (rstep R')"
obtains q w where "(q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q)"
proof -
  have hcne:"hole_pos C ≠ []" using nC 
    by (metis ctxt_of_pos_term.simps(1) ctxt_of_pos_term_hole_pos)
  have "is_Fun l" using wf[unfolded wf_trs_def] lr R' by auto
  hence "is_Fun (l ⋅ σ)" by auto
  moreover have *:"hole_pos C ∈ poss C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" by simp
  moreover have **:"is_Fun (C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ |_ (hole_pos C))" 
    by (simp add: calculation(1))
  from poss_is_Fun_fun_poss[OF * **]
  have hcfun:"hole_pos C ∈ fun_poss C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
  have poss_us:"∀q ∈ poss u. u |_ q = Fun ≐ [u, v] |_ (0 # q)" by auto  
  have poss_vs:"∀q' ∈ poss v. v |_ q' = Fun ≐ [u, v] |_ (1 # q')"  by auto
  have "∃q r. (q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q) ∨ (r ∈ poss v ∧ hole_pos C = 1 # r)" using fuv nC hcne hcfun 
  proof(auto, goal_cases)
    case (1 x p)
    then show ?case 
      by (metis fun_poss_imp_poss length_nth_simps(3) less_Suc0 less_SucE nth_Cons_Suc)
  next
    case (2 x p)
    then show ?case 
      by (metis diff_Suc_1 fun_poss_imp_poss less_Suc0 less_SucE nth_Cons')
  next
    case (3 x p)
    then show ?case
      by (metis fun_poss_imp_poss length_nth_simps(3) less_Suc0 less_SucE)
  qed  
  hence "∃q r. (q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q)" using vNF 
    by (metis NF_iff_no_step One_nat_def fuv lr poss_vs replace_at_ident rstepI subt_at_hole_pos)
  then show ?thesis using that by auto
qed

lemma funas_R_reachable_case:assumes funas_u:"funas_term u ⊆ F"
  and funas_v:"funas_term v ⊆ F"
  and uvU:"(Fun ≐ [u, v], U) ∈ rstep R'"
shows "∃u' v'. (U = Fun ≐ [u', v] ∧ funas_term u' ⊆ F) ∨ (U = Fun ≐ [u, v'] ∧ funas_term v' ⊆ F)"
proof -
  from uvU obtain C l r σ where lr:"(l, r) ∈ R'" and fuv:"Fun ≐ [u, v] = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and U:"U = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
  from lr have flσ:"funas_term (l ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" and frσ:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" using wf_F_subst 
    by (simp add: R_sig lhs_wf, meson R_sig lr rhs_wf wf_F_subst) 
  with fuv have nC:"C ≠ Hole" using D D_fresh numeral_2_eq_2 by force
  from obtain_hole_pos_fun_uv[OF fuv lr nC]
  obtain q w where qpos:"(q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q) ∨ (w ∈ poss v ∧ hole_pos C = 1 # w)" by auto
  then show ?thesis
  proof
    assume asm:"q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q"
    have U':"U = replace_at C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ (hole_pos C) (r ⋅ σ)" using U by auto
    have lσuq:"l ⋅ σ = u |_ q" using asm fuv by (metis nth_Cons_0 subt_at.simps(2) subt_at_hole_pos)
    let ?u = "replace_at u q (r ⋅ σ)"
    have frσ:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" using R_sig wf_F_subst frσ unfolding funas_defs by auto
    have *:"U = Fun ≐ [?u, v]" using U' fuv rule exI[of _ ?u] asm lσuq by auto
    have **:"funas_term ?u ⊆ F" using funas_u * frσ by (metis asm ctxt_supt_id funas_term_ctxt_apply le_sup_iff)
    show ?thesis by (rule exI[of _ ?u], rule exI[of _ v], insert * **, auto) 
  next
    assume asm:"w ∈ poss v ∧ hole_pos C = 1 # w"
    have U':"U = replace_at C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ (hole_pos C) (r ⋅ σ)" using U by auto
    have lσuq:"l ⋅ σ = v |_ w" using asm fuv
      by (metis One_nat_def nth_Cons_0 nth_Cons_Suc subt_at.simps(2) subt_at_hole_pos)
    let ?v = "replace_at v w (r ⋅ σ)"
    have frσ:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" using R_sig wf_F_subst frσ unfolding funas_defs by auto
    have *:"U = Fun ≐ [u, ?v]" using U' fuv rule exI[of _ ?v] asm lσuq by auto
    have **:"funas_term ?v ⊆ F" using funas_v * frσ by (metis asm ctxt_supt_id funas_term_ctxt_apply le_sup_iff)
    show ?thesis by (rule exI[of _ u], rule exI[of _ ?v], insert * **, auto) 
  qed
qed

lemma funas_R_reachable_case_right_irreducible:assumes funas_u:"funas_term u ⊆ F"
  and funas_v:"funas_term v ⊆ F"
  and uvU:"(Fun ≐ [u, v], U) ∈ rstep R'"
  and vNF:"v ∈ NF (rstep R')"
shows "∃u'. (U = Fun ≐ [u', v] ∧ funas_term u' ⊆ F)"
proof -
  from uvU obtain C l r σ where lr:"(l, r) ∈ R'" and fuv:"Fun ≐ [u, v] = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and U:"U = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
  from lr have flσ:"funas_term (l ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" and frσ:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" using wf_F_subst 
    by (simp add: R_sig lhs_wf, meson R_sig lr rhs_wf wf_F_subst) 
  with fuv have nC:"C ≠ Hole" using D D_fresh numeral_2_eq_2 by force
  from obtain_hole_pos_fun_uv_right_irreducible[OF fuv lr nC vNF]
  obtain q  where qpos:"(q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q)" by auto
  have U':"U = replace_at C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ (hole_pos C) (r ⋅ σ)" using U by auto
  have lσuq:"l ⋅ σ = u |_ q" using qpos fuv by (metis nth_Cons_0 subt_at.simps(2) subt_at_hole_pos)
  let ?u = "replace_at u q (r ⋅ σ)"
  have frσ:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" using R_sig wf_F_subst frσ unfolding funas_defs by auto
  have *:"U = Fun ≐ [?u, v]" using U' fuv rule exI[of _ ?u] qpos lσuq by auto
  have **:"funas_term ?u ⊆ F" using funas_u * frσ by (metis qpos ctxt_supt_id funas_term_ctxt_apply le_sup_iff)
  show ?thesis by (rule exI[of _ ?u], insert * **, auto)
qed

lemma fun_rstep_case1': assumes funas_u:"funas_term u ⊆ F"
  and funas_v:"funas_term v ⊆ F"
shows "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ≐ [u, v']) ∈ rstep R' ⟹ (v, v') ∈ (rstep R')⇧*" using assms
proof -
  assume "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ≐ [u, v']) ∈ rstep R'"
  then obtain C σ l r where lr:"(l, r) ∈ R'" and fuv:"Fun ≐ [u, v] = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and fuv':"Fun ≐ [u, v'] = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
  from lr have flσ:"funas_term (l ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" and frσ:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" using wf_F_subst 
    by (simp add: R_sig lhs_wf, meson R_sig lr rhs_wf wf_F_subst) 
  with fuv have nC:"C ≠ Hole" using D D_fresh numeral_2_eq_2 by force
  from obtain_hole_pos_fun_uv[OF fuv lr nC]
  obtain q w where qpos:"(q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q) ∨ (w ∈ poss v ∧ hole_pos C = 1 # w)" by auto
  then show ?thesis 
  proof
    assume asm:"q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q"
    have fuv'eq:"Fun ≐ [u, v'] = replace_at C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ (hole_pos C) (r ⋅ σ)" using fuv' by auto
    have lσuq:"l ⋅ σ = u |_ q" using asm fuv by (metis nth_Cons_0 subt_at.simps(2) subt_at_hole_pos)
    let ?u = "replace_at u q (r ⋅ σ)"
    have *:"Fun ≐ [u, v'] = Fun ≐ [?u, v]" using fuv' fuv asm lσuq fuv'eq by auto
    have "v = v'" using * by auto
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    assume asm:"w ∈ poss v ∧ hole_pos C = 1 # w"
    have fuv'eq:"Fun ≐ [u, v'] = replace_at C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ (hole_pos C) (r ⋅ σ)" using fuv' by auto
    have lσvw:"l ⋅ σ = v |_ w" using asm fuv 
      by (metis One_nat_def nth_Cons_0 nth_Cons_Suc subt_at.simps(2) subt_at_hole_pos)
    let ?v = "replace_at v w (r ⋅ σ)"
    have frσ:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" using R_sig wf_F_subst frσ unfolding funas_defs by auto
    have *:"Fun ≐ [u, v'] = Fun ≐ [u, ?v]" using fuv' fuv fuv'eq asm lσvw by auto
    let ?D = "ctxt_of_pos_term w v"
    have "?D⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ = v" using asm by (simp add: ctxt_supt_id lσvw)
    moreover have "?D⟨r ⋅ σ⟩ = ?v" using * asm by auto 
    moreover have "(v, ?v) ∈ (rstep R')" using rstep.intros[of l r R' v ?D σ ?v] 
      using calculation lr by fastforce
    ultimately show ?thesis using * by blast
  qed
qed

lemma fun_rstep_case1: assumes funas_u:"funas_term u ⊆ F"
  and funas_v:"funas_term v ⊆ F"
shows "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ≐ [u, v']) ∈ rstep R' ⟹ (v, v') ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔⇧*" using assms fun_rstep_case1' by auto

lemma fun_rstep_case2': assumes funas_u:"funas_term u ⊆ F"
  and funas_v:"funas_term v ⊆ F"
shows "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ≐ [u', v]) ∈ rstep R' ⟹ (u, u') ∈ (rstep R')⇧*" 
proof -
  assume "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ≐ [u', v]) ∈ rstep R'"
  then obtain C σ l r where lr:"(l, r) ∈ R'" and fuv:"Fun ≐ [u, v] = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and fuv':"Fun ≐ [u', v] = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
  from lr have flσ:"funas_term (l ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" and frσ:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" using wf_F_subst 
    by (simp add: R_sig lhs_wf, meson R_sig lr rhs_wf wf_F_subst) 
  with fuv have nC:"C ≠ Hole" using D D_fresh numeral_2_eq_2 by force
  from obtain_hole_pos_fun_uv[OF fuv lr nC]
  obtain q w where qpos:"(q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q) ∨ (w ∈ poss v ∧ hole_pos C = 1 # w)" by auto
  then show ?thesis 
  proof
    assume asm:"q ∈ poss u ∧ hole_pos C = 0 # q"
    have fu'veq:"Fun ≐ [u', v] = replace_at C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ (hole_pos C) (r ⋅ σ)" using fuv' by auto
    have lσuq:"l ⋅ σ = u |_ q" using asm fuv
      by (metis nth_Cons_0 subt_at.simps(2) subt_at_hole_pos)
    let ?u = "replace_at u q (r ⋅ σ)"
    have frσ:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" using R_sig wf_F_subst frσ unfolding funas_defs by auto
    have *:"Fun ≐ [u', v] = Fun ≐ [?u, v]" using fuv' fuv fu'veq asm lσuq by auto
    let ?D = "ctxt_of_pos_term q u"
    have "?D⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ = u" using asm by (simp add: ctxt_supt_id lσuq)
    moreover have "?D⟨r ⋅ σ⟩ = ?u" using * asm by auto 
    moreover have "(u, ?u) ∈ (rstep R')" using rstep.intros[of l r R' u ?D σ ?u] 
      using calculation lr by fastforce
    ultimately show ?thesis using * by auto
  next
    assume asm:"w ∈ poss v ∧ hole_pos C = 1 # w"
    have fu'veq:"Fun ≐ [u', v] = replace_at C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩ (hole_pos C) (r ⋅ σ)" using fuv' by auto
    have lσuq:"l ⋅ σ = v |_ w" using asm fuv 
      by (metis One_nat_def nth_Cons_0 nth_Cons_Suc subt_at.simps(2) subt_at_hole_pos)
    let ?v = "replace_at v w (r ⋅ σ)"
    have *:"Fun ≐ [u', v] = Fun ≐ [u, ?v]" using fuv' fuv asm lσuq fu'veq by simp
    have "u = u'" using * by auto
    then show ?thesis by auto
  qed
qed

lemma fun_rstep_case2: assumes funas_u:"funas_term u ⊆ F"
  and funas_v:"funas_term v ⊆ F"
shows "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ≐ [u', v]) ∈ rstep R' ⟹ (u, u') ∈ (rstep R')⇧↔⇧*" using fun_rstep_case2' assms by auto

lemma rstep_red_equiv: assumes fun_uv:"funas_rule (u, v) ⊆ F"
  and fr:"(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ⊤ []) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*"
  and vNF:"v ∈ NF (rstep R')"
shows "((u, v) ∈ (rstep R')⇧*)" using fr
proof -
  let ?srule = "λx. (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])"
  have fr:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" using D 
    unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
  have frD:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) ⊆ D" using D 
    unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
  from fun_uv obtain n where n1:"n ≥ 1" and fuv:"(Fun (≐) [u, v], Fun (⊤) []) ∈ (rstep R)^^n"
    by (metis One_nat_def Suc_leI assms(2) bot_nat_0.not_eq_extremum list.distinct(1) relpow_0_E 
        rtrancl_power term.inject(2))
  then show ?thesis using fun_uv vNF
  proof(induct n arbitrary:u v)
    case 0
    then show ?case by auto
  next
    case (Suc n)
    from Suc(4) have funas_u:"funas_term u ⊆ F" unfolding funas_defs by auto
    from Suc(4) have funas_v:"funas_term v ⊆ F" unfolding funas_defs by auto
    from Suc(3) obtain U where U1:"(Fun ≐ [u, v], U) ∈ rstep R" and U2:"(U, Fun (⊤) []) ∈ (rstep R)^^ n"
      using Suc(2) by (meson relpow_Suc_E2)
    then show ?case
    proof(cases "Suc n = Suc 0")
      case True
      with Suc(3) have "(Fun ≐ [u, v], Fun ⊤ []) ∈ rstep R" by simp
      then obtain C σ l r where lr:"(l, r) ∈ R" and lhs:"Fun ≐ [u, v] = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and rhs:"Fun ⊤ [] = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩" by auto
      have rule_type:"(l, r) ∈ R' ∨ (∃x. (l, r) = ?srule x)" using R' lr by fastforce
      hence frule_type:"funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F ∨ (∃x. (l, r) = ?srule x)" using R_sig 
        by (metis fst_conv funas_rule_def le_supI lhs_wf rhs_wf snd_conv)
      have fnlr:"¬ funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F"
      proof(rule ccontr)
        assume "¬ ?thesis"
        hence flr:"funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F" using D D_fresh by auto
        from rhs have "funas_term  (C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩) ⊆ D" using D by auto
        hence *:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ D" by auto
        from flr have "funas_term r ⊆ F" unfolding funas_defs by auto
        hence **:"funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ⊆ F" using wf_F_subst by simp
        have "C = Hole" using rhs by (metis nectxt_imp_supt_ctxt supt_const)
        hence "funas_term (r ⋅ σ) ≠ {}" using rhs by auto 
        then show False using * ** D_fresh by auto
      qed
      hence **:"(∃x. (l, r) = ?srule x)" using fr frule_type by auto
      hence "u = v" using lr lhs rhs by auto
      then show ?thesis by auto
    next
      case False
      hence UN:"U ≠ Fun (⊤) []" using not_reducible_T U2 by (metis relpow_E2)
      have *:"(Fun ≐ [u, v], U) ∈ rstep R'"
      proof(rule ccontr)
        assume asm:"¬ ?thesis"
        hence "(Fun ≐ [u, v], U) ∉ rstep R'" by auto
        hence "∃x. (Fun ≐ [u, v], U) ∈ rstep {?srule x}" using R' by (metis U1 Un_iff rstep_union)
        then obtain x where "(Fun ≐ [u, v], U) ∈ rstep {?srule x}" by auto
        then obtain C' σ' l' r' where l'r':"(l', r') ∈ {?srule x}" and fuv:"Fun ≐ [u, v] = C'⟨l' ⋅ σ'⟩" 
          and UC':"U = C'⟨r' ⋅ σ'⟩" by auto
        have "r' ⋅ σ' =  Fun (⊤) []" using l'r' by auto
        with UN UC' have NC':"C' ≠ Hole" by auto
        hence "l' ⋅ σ' ⊲ Fun ≐ [u, v]" using fuv by auto
        hence *:"l' ⋅ σ' ⊴ u ∨ l' ⋅ σ' ⊴ v" by auto
        have "(≐, 2) ∈ funas_term (l' ⋅ σ')" using l'r' by auto
        then show False using funas_u funas_v D D_fresh *
          by (meson insert_disjoint(1) subset_iff supteq_imp_funas_term_subset) 
      qed         
      from funas_R_reachable_case_right_irreducible[OF funas_u funas_v this Suc(5)]
      obtain u'  where U:"U = (Fun ≐ [u', v])" and fu':"funas_term u' ⊆ F" 
        using funas_u funas_v vNF by auto
      have IH:"(u', v) ∈ (rstep R')⇧*" 
      proof (rule Suc(1))
        show "1 ≤ n" using False by auto
        show "(Fun ≐ [u', v], Fun ⊤ []) ∈ rstep R ^^ n" 
          using U U2 by auto
        show "funas_rule (u', v) ⊆ F" 
          by (simp add: fu' funas_rule_def funas_v)
        show "v ∈ NF_trs R'" using Suc(5) by auto
      qed
      have "(u, u') ∈ (rstep R')⇧*"  using fun_rstep_case2' U U1 * funas_u funas_v by blast
      then show ?thesis using IH by auto
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma norm_subst_rstep_preserve: assumes normθ':"normal_subst R θ'" 
  and norm:"(∀x. (θ x, θ' x) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*)"
shows "(Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ, t ⋅ θ], Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ', t ⋅ θ']) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" 
proof -
  have sθsθ':"(s ⋅ θ, s ⋅ θ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using norm by (simp add: substs_rsteps)
  have tθtθ':"(t ⋅ θ, t ⋅ θ') ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using norm by (simp add: substs_rsteps)
  let ?C = "ctxt_of_pos_term [0] (Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ, t ⋅ θ])"
  let ?C' = "ctxt_of_pos_term [1] (Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ', t ⋅ θ])"
  from rsteps_closed_ctxt[OF sθsθ', of ?C]
  have "(Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ, t ⋅ θ], Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ', t ⋅ θ]) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" by auto
  moreover from rsteps_closed_ctxt[OF tθtθ', of ?C']
  have "(Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ', t ⋅ θ], Fun ≐ [s ⋅ θ', t ⋅ θ']) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" by auto
  ultimately show ?thesis by auto
qed

(* Lemma 3.4 in MH94 using equational terms *)
lemma lifting_lemma_equational_terms:
  fixes V::"('v::infinite) set" and S::"('f, 'v)term" and T::"('f, 'v)term"
  assumes "normal_subst R θ"
    and "wf_equational_term S"
    and "T = S ⋅ θ"
    and "vars_term S ∪ subst_domain θ ⊆ V"
    and rs:"(T,  T') ∈ (rstep R)⇧*"
    and fv:"finite V"
  shows "∃σ θ' S'. narrowing_derivation S S' σ ∧ T' = S' ⋅ θ' ∧ wf_equational_term S' ∧
      normal_subst R θ' ∧ (σ ∘⇩s θ') |s V = θ |s V "
proof -
  from rs
  obtain f n where f0:"f 0 = T" and fn:"f n = T'" and rel_chain:"∀i < n. (f i,  f (Suc i)) ∈ rstep R" 
    by (metis rtrancl_imp_seq)
  then have "∃σ θ' S'. narrowing_derivation_num S S' σ n ∧ T' = S' ⋅ θ' ∧ wf_equational_term S' ∧ 
    normal_subst R θ' ∧ (σ ∘⇩s θ') |s V = θ |s V" using assms
  proof(induct n arbitrary: S T T' θ f V rule: wf_induct[OF wf_measure [of "λ n. n"]])
    case (1 n)
    note IH1 = 1(1)[rule_format]
    then show ?case
    proof(cases "n = 0")
      case True
      show ?thesis
        by (rule exI[of _ Var], rule exI[of _ θ], rule exI[of _ "S"], insert 1 True)
          (simp add: narrowing_derivation_num_def subst_rule_def relpow_fun_conv, force) 
    next
      case False
      hence f0f1:"(f 0, f 1) ∈ rstep R" using 1 by auto
      then show ?thesis
      proof -
        from f0f1 obtain C σ l r  where f0:"f 0 = C⟨l ⋅ σ⟩" and f1:"f 1 = C⟨r ⋅ σ⟩"
          and rl:"(l, r) ∈ R" by auto
        have normθ:"normal_subst R θ" by fact
        have sθt:"S ⋅ θ = T" using f0 1 by auto
        obtain ω where varempty':"V ∩ vars_rule (ω ∙ (l, r)) = {}" using ‹finite V›
          by (metis rule_fs.rename_avoiding supp_vars_rule_eq vars_rule_def)
        have "is_Fun l" using wf[unfolded wf_trs_def] rl 
          by (simp add: is_Fun_Fun_conv wf_trs_imp_lhs_Fun)
        hence hpC:"hole_pos C ∈ fun_poss (f 0)" 
          by (metis f0 hole_pos_poss is_VarE is_VarI poss_is_Fun_fun_poss subst_apply_eq_Var subt_at_hole_pos)
        obtain ωr where ωr:"ωr ∙ (ω ∙ (l, r)) ∈ R" by (metis rl rule_pt.permute_minus_cancel(2))
        let ?p = "hole_pos C"
        have f0p:"(f 0) |_ ?p = l ⋅ σ" using f0 by auto
        have pf0:"?p ∈ fun_poss (f 0)" using hpC by auto
        hence pp0:"?p ∈ poss (f 0)" by (simp add: fun_poss_imp_poss) 
        have p:"?p ∈ poss S" 
        proof(rule ccontr)
          assume "¬ ?thesis"
          hence pns:"?p ∉ poss S" by simp
          hence pnfs:"?p ∉ fun_poss S" using fun_poss_imp_poss by blast
          have sub_eq:"(S ⋅ θ) |_ ?p = l ⋅ σ" by (metis 1(2) 1(7) f0 subt_at_hole_pos)
          have psθ:"?p ∈ fun_poss (S ⋅ θ)" using 1(2) 1(7) pf0 by auto
          from poss_subst_apply_term[of ?p S θ]
          obtain q r x where qpr:"?p = q @ r" and qs:"q ∈ poss S" and sqx:"S |_ q = Var x" and r:"r ∈ poss (θ x)"
            using fun_poss_imp_poss pnfs psθ by blast
          hence *:"(S ⋅ θ) |_ ?p = (Var x) ⋅ θ |_ r" by force
          have "((Var x) ⋅ θ) ∈ NF (rstep R)" using normθ by (simp add: normal_subst_def)
              (metis NF_I NF_Var local.wf notin_subst_domain_imp_Var)
          hence "((Var x) ⋅ θ |_ r) ∈ NF (rstep R)" unfolding normal_subst_def using r
            by (metis NF_subterm eval_term.simps(1) subt_at_imp_supteq)
          then show False by (metis * NF_instance lhs_notin_NF_rstep rl sub_eq)
        qed
        hence pfun':"?p ∈ fun_poss (S ⋅ θ)" using p pp0 pf0 sθt f0p f0 ‹ f 0 = T› ‹is_Fun l› normθ[unfolded normal_subst_def]
          by auto 
        have sub:"is_Fun S" using 1(6)[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] by auto 
        hence pfun:"?p ∈ fun_poss S" using pfun' p  p normθ[unfolded normal_subst_def]
          by (smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) "1.prems"(1) NF_instance eval_term.simps(1) f0p fun_poss_fun_conv is_Fun_Fun_conv is_Var_def lhs_notin_NF_rstep notin_subst_domain_imp_Var poss_is_Fun_fun_poss rl sθt subt_at_subst)
        hence vuS':"vars_term (S |_ ?p) ⊆ vars_term S"
        proof -
          from vars_term_subt_at[OF p]
          have "vars_term (S |_ ?p) ⊆ vars_term S" by auto
          then show ?thesis by auto
        qed
        with varempty' have varcond:"vars_term (S |_ ?p) ∩ vars_rule (ω ∙ (l, r)) = {}" using 1(10) 1(8) by blast
        have "∃σr. ∀x. σr (ω ∙ x) = σ x" using atom_pt.permute_minus_cancel(2) by (metis o_apply)
        then obtain σr where σrdef:"∀t. σr (ω ∙ t) = σ t" by auto
        hence "∀xs. subst_list σr (ω ∙ xs) = subst_list σ xs" unfolding subst_list_def
        proof(auto, goal_cases)
          case (1 xs s t)
          hence "(ω ∙ s) ⋅ σr = s ⋅ σ" 
            by (metis permute_term.simps(1) permute_term_subst_apply_term 
                subst_compose_def subst_monoid_mult.mult.left_neutral term_subst_eq_conv) 
          then show ?case 
            by (metis fst_conv rule_pt.fst_eqvt)
        next
          case (2 xs s t)
          hence "(ω ∙ t) ⋅ σr = t ⋅ σ" 
            by (metis permute_term.simps(1) permute_term_subst_apply_term 
                subst_compose_def subst_monoid_mult.mult.left_neutral term_subst_eq_conv) 
          then show ?case 
            by (metis snd_conv rule_pt.snd_eqvt)
        qed
        hence σr1:"subst_list σr [ω ∙ (l,r)]  = subst_list σ [(l,r)]" unfolding subst_list_def  
          using rule_pt.fst_eqvt rule_pt.snd_eqvt 
          by (smt (verit) list.simps(8) list.simps(9) rules_pt.permute_list_def)
        hence subeq:"subst_rule σr (ω ∙ (l,r))  = subst_rule σ (l, r)" unfolding subst_rule_def subst_list_def by auto
        let ?σdom = "vars_rule (ω ∙ (l, r))"
        let ?σr = "σr |s (?σdom)"
        let ?θ = " θ |s V"
        have sub_σr:"subst_domain ?σr ⊆ (vars_rule (ω ∙ (l, r)))"
          by (metis inf_le1 restrict_subst subst_domain_restrict_subst_domain)
        have sub_θ:"subst_domain ?θ ⊆ V" using 1(8) by auto
        have inter_empty:"subst_domain ?σr ∩ subst_domain ?θ = {}" using varempty' sub_σr sub_θ by auto
        from  sθt f0p have *:"(S ⋅ θ |_ ?p) = fst (ω ∙ (l, r)) ⋅ σr" using subeq
          by (simp add: 1(2) subst_rule_def)
        have varcond':"vars_term (S |_ ?p) ∩ vars_term (ω ∙ l) = {}" 
        proof -
          have "vars_term (ω ∙ l) ⊆ vars_rule (ω ∙ (l, r))" 
            by (metis fst_conv rule_pt.fst_eqvt sup_ge1 vars_rule_def)
          then show ?thesis using varcond by auto
        qed
        with normθ * have **:"(S |_ ?p) ⋅ θ = fst (ω ∙ (l, r)) ⋅ σr" by (simp add: p)
        have sub_eq:"(S |_ ?p) ⋅ ?θ = (ω ∙ l) ⋅ ?σr" using **
          by (metis 1(8) coincidence_lemma' fst_conv le_sup_iff rule_pt.permute_prod.simps subst_domain_neutral sup_ge1 vars_rule_def)
        from subst_union_sound[OF sub_eq]
        have subst_eq_θσ:"(S |_ ?p) ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)  = (ω ∙ l) ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)" using inter_empty sub_σr sub_θ inter_empty 
          by (smt (verit, best) disjoint_iff fst_conv local.wf rl sub_comm sub_eq subsetD subst_union.elims 
              term_subst_eq_conv varcond' varempty' vars_rule_eqvt vars_rule_lhs vars_term_eqvt)
        then obtain δ where mgu_uv:"mgu (S |_ ?p) (ω ∙ l) = Some δ" using mgu_ex 
          by (meson ex_mgu_if_subst_apply_term_eq_subst_apply_term)
        from mgu_sound[OF mgu_uv] have δ:"(?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) =  δ ∘⇩s (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)" using subst_eq_θσ 
          by (smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) is_imgu_def subst_monoid_mult.mult_assoc the_mgu the_mgu_is_imgu)
        have subst_range_disjδ:"subst_domain δ ∩ range_vars δ = {}" using mgu_uv mgu_subst_domain_range_vars_disjoint by blast
        have crl:"(ω ∙ r) ⋅ σr = (r ⋅ σ)" by (metis rule_pt.snd_eqvt snd_conv subeq subst_rule_def)
        from subst_domain_restrict_subst_domain[of ?σdom σr]
        have subinter:"subst_domain ?σr = subst_domain σr ∩ ?σdom" by auto
        have sndeq:"(ω ∙ r) ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) = r ⋅ σ" by (smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) Un_Int_eq(4) coincidence_lemma' crl 
              inf.absorb_iff2 inf_bot_right inf_commute inf_left_commute restrict_subst rule_pt.snd_eqvt snd_conv 
              subst_domain_restrict_subst_domain subst_union_term_reduction varempty' vars_rule_def)
        let ?S1 = "(replace_at S ?p (ω ∙ r))⋅ δ"
        have nar:"(S, ?S1, δ) ∈ narrowing_step" unfolding subst_rule_def narrowing_step_def using  ωr mgu_uv rl varempty' pfun by auto 
            (smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) 1(8) Int_assoc fst_conv inf.orderE inf_bot_right le_sup_iff narrowing_step.simps 
              narrowing_stepp_narrowing_step_eq rule_pt.fst_eqvt rule_pt.snd_eqvt snd_conv subst_apply_term_ctxt_apply_distrib)
        from narrowing_set_imp_rtran[OF nar]
        have condn1:"narrowing_derivation_num S ?S1 δ 1" by auto
        let ?V = "(V - subst_domain δ) ∪ range_vars δ"
        let ?θ1 = "(?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) |s ?V"
        have subθ1:"subst_domain ?θ1 ⊆ ?V" unfolding subst_restrict_def 
          by (smt (verit, del_insts) mem_Collect_eq subset_eq subst_domain_def)
        have reseq:"?θ1 |s ?V = (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)|s ?V" 
          by (simp add: restrict_subst_domain_def)
        have reseqδ:"(δ ∘⇩s ?θ1) |s V = (δ ∘⇩s (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr))|s V" 
          using r_subst_compose reseq by blast
        have reseqθ:"(δ ∘⇩s ?θ1) |s V = θ |s V " using 1(8) δ by auto (smt (verit, best) δ disjoint_iff notin_subst_domain_imp_Var 
              reseqδ restrict_subst restrict_subst_domain_def subst_domain_neutral subst_ext subst_union.elims varempty')
        have "normal_subst R (?θ1 |s ?V)"
        proof -
          let ?δ = "δ |s V"
          let ?B = "(V - subst_domain δ) ∪ range_vars ?δ"
          have normV:"normal_subst R (θ |s V)" using normθ 1(8) by auto
          have BV:"?B ⊆ V - subst_domain δ ∪ range_vars (δ |s V)" by auto
          from restricted_normalized[OF normV reseqθ BV]
          have normB:"normal_subst R (?θ1 |s ?B)" by auto 
          have ranB:"range_vars δ ⊆ ?B"
          proof
            fix x
            assume asm:"x ∈ range_vars δ"
            hence xnδ:"x ∉ subst_domain δ" using δ
              by (meson disjoint_iff mgu_subst_domain_range_vars_disjoint mgu_uv)
            have subst_x:"x ∈ vars_term (S |_ ?p) ∪ vars_term (ω ∙ l)" using mgu_uv 
                asm mgu_range_vars by auto
            then show "x ∈ ?B"
            proof
              assume "x ∈ vars_term (S |_ ?p)"
              hence "x ∈ V - subst_domain δ" using 1(8) xnδ vuS' by auto
              then show ?thesis by auto
            next
              assume asm2:"x ∈ vars_term (ω ∙ l)"
              hence xnu:"x ∉ vars_term (S |_ ?p)" using varcond' by blast
              from vars_term_range[OF asm asm2 subst_range_disjδ]
              have xvδ:"x ∈ vars_term ((ω ∙ l) ⋅ δ)" by auto
              have *:"x ∈ vars_term (S |_ ?p ⋅ δ)" using mgu_uv xvδ
                by (simp add: subst_apply_term_eq_subst_apply_term_if_mgu) 
              hence "vars_term ((ω ∙ l) ⋅ δ) = vars_term (S |_ ?p ⋅ δ)" using mgu_uv 
                by (simp add: subst_apply_term_eq_subst_apply_term_if_mgu)
              from subst_restricted_range_vars[OF * subst_range_disjδ xnu asm]
              have "x ∈ range_vars (δ |s vars_term (S |_ ?p))" by auto
              moreover have upV:"vars_term (S |_ ?p) ⊆ V" using 1(8) vuS' by auto
              ultimately have "x ∈ range_vars (δ |s V)" unfolding range_vars_def subst_restrict_def
                by (auto simp add: subsetD subst_domain_def) 
              then show ?thesis by auto
            qed
          qed
          hence "?B = ?V"
          proof -
            have "range_vars ?δ ⊆ range_vars δ"  unfolding subst_restrict_def range_vars_def  
              by (auto, smt (verit) mem_Collect_eq subst_domain_def, simp add: subst_domain_def)
            then show ?thesis using ranB by blast
          qed
          then show ?thesis using normB by auto
        qed
        hence normθ1:"normal_subst R ?θ1" using subθ1 reseq by fastforce
        have wf_S1:"wf_equational_term ?S1"
        proof - 
          let ?srule = "λx. (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])"
          have fr:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" using D 
            unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
          have cd:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) ⊆ D" using D 
            unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
          have wf_S:"wf_equational_term S" by (simp add: 1(6))
          have ωrl:"(l, r) ∈ R' ∨ (∃x. (l, r) = ?srule x)" using R' rl by fastforce
          moreover have ωrl_un:"funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F  ∨ (∃x. (l, r) = ?srule x)" 
            using R_sig by (metis Trs.funas_defs(2) calculation fst_conv le_sup_iff lhs_wf rhs_wf snd_conv)
          ultimately have "funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F ∨ funas_rule (l, r) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}"
            using fr by metis
          then consider (ordinary) "funas_rule (l, r) ⊆ F" | (special) "funas_rule (l, r) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" 
            using ωrl by auto
          hence "wf_equational_term (replace_at S ?p (ω ∙ r))"
          proof(cases)
            case ordinary
            hence rlR':"(l, r) ∈ R'" using R' D R_sig D_fresh 
              by (metis Int_absorb2 ωrl fr insert_not_empty)
            from ordinary have *:"funas_rule (ω ∙ (l, r)) ⊆ F" using funas_rule_perm by blast
            have **:"root (ω ∙ l) = root l" using root_perm_inv by metis
            from fun_root_not_None[OF ‹is_Fun l›] have nroot:"root l ≠ None" by auto
            from root_not_special_symbols[OF rlR' ordinary nroot]
            have "root l ≠ Some (≐, 2) ∧ root l ≠  Some (⊤, 0)" by simp
            hence rn:"root(ω ∙ l) ≠ Some (≐, 2) ∧ root(ω ∙ l) ≠ Some (⊤, 0)" 
              by (simp add: "**")
            have "root (S |_ ?p) = root ((ω ∙ l) ⋅ σr)" using root_subst_inv 
              by (metis coincidence_lemma fst_conv pfun local.wf rl sub_eq vars_rule_eqvt vars_rule_lhs vars_term_eqvt)
            also have "... = root(ω ∙ l)" using wf[unfolded wf[unfolded wf_trs_def]] root_subst_inv 
              by (metis ** empty_pos_in_poss is_Var_def nroot poss_is_Fun_fun_poss root.simps(1) subt_at.simps(1))
            finally have root_eq:"root (S |_ ?p) = root(ω ∙ l)" by auto
            hence "root (S |_ ?p) ≠ Some (≐, 2) ∧ root (S |_ ?p) ≠ Some (⊤, 0)" using rn by auto
            hence np:"?p ≠ []" using wf_S[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] by force
            hence uf:"S ≠ Fun (⊤) []" using pfun by auto
            from wf_S[unfolded wf_equational_term_def]
            obtain v w where u:"S = Fun ≐ [v, w] ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term v ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term w"
              using uf by auto
            have "funas_term (ω ∙ r) ⊆ F" using * unfolding funas_defs 
              by (metis R_sig funas_term_perm rhs_wf rlR')
            then show ?thesis by (simp add: np wf_equational_term_safe_replace wf_S uf pfun)
          next
            case special
            have "funas_rule (ω ∙ (l,r)) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}"
            proof(rule ccontr)
              assume asm:"¬ ?thesis"
              have "funas_rule (l, r) = D" using special
                by (simp add: D)
              hence "funas_rule (ω ∙ (l, r)) = D" using funas_rule_perm 
                by (metis rule_pt.permute_minus_cancel(2) subsetI subset_antisym)
              then show False using asm D by simp
            qed
            hence "∃x. fst (ω ∙ (l, r)) = fst (?srule x)"
            proof -
              from special have "∃y. l = fst (?srule y)" using ωrl
                using D D_fresh ωrl_un by auto
              then obtain y where "l = fst (?srule y)" by auto
              hence "l ⋅ ((sop ω)::('f, 'v) subst) = (fst (?srule y)) ⋅ ((sop ω)::('f, 'v) subst)" by auto
              hence "ω ∙ l = (fst (?srule y)) ⋅ ((sop ω)::('f, 'v) subst) "
                by (simp add: rule_pt.fst_eqvt rule_pt.snd_eqvt subst_equation_def)
              moreover have "∃x. (fst (?srule y)) ⋅ ((sop ω)::('f, 'v) subst) =
                  fst (?srule x)" unfolding subst_equation_def by auto
              ultimately show ?thesis by (smt (verit, best) fst_conv rule_pt.fst_eqvt)
            qed
            then obtain x where ω'rl:"fst (ω ∙ (l, r)) = fst (?srule x)" by auto
            have rclhs:"root (fst (ω ∙ (l, r))) = Some (≐, 2)" using ω'rl by auto
            have crhs_ω'rl:"(snd (ω ∙ (l, r))) = Fun (⊤) []" using ω'rl
              by (metis D D_fresh ωrl_un insert_disjoint(1) insert_subset list.simps(8) permute_Fun 
                  rule_pt.snd_eqvt snd_conv special terms_pt.permute_list_def)
            have isFunω':"is_Fun (ω ∙ l)" using ‹is_Fun l›  ω'rl by auto
            from fun_root_not_None[OF isFunω'] have nroot:"root (ω ∙ l) ≠ None" by auto
            have rclhsσr:"root ((ω ∙ l) ⋅ σr) = Some (≐, 2)" using ω'rl 
              by (metis empty_pos_in_poss fst_conv is_Fun_Fun_conv poss_is_Fun_fun_poss rclhs root_subst_inv 
                  rule_pt.fst_eqvt subt_at.simps(1))
            have "root (S |_ ?p) = root ((ω ∙ l) ⋅ σr)" using pfun root_subst_inv 
              by (metis ** fst_conv rule_pt.fst_eqvt)
            also have "... = root(ω ∙ l)" using wf[unfolded wf_trs_def] root_subst_inv 
              by (metis fst_conv rclhs rclhsσr rule_pt.fst_eqvt)
            finally have root_eq:"root (S |_ ?p) = root(ω ∙ l)" by auto
            with ** pfun have root_u:"root (S|_ ?p) = Some (≐, 2)" using rclhs 
              by (metis fst_conv rule_pt.fst_eqvt)
            have un:"S ≠ Fun (⊤) []"
            proof(rule ccontr)
              assume "¬ ?thesis"
              hence "S = Fun (⊤) []" by auto
              hence "funas_term S = {(⊤, 0)}" by auto
              then show False using root_u subterm_funas pfun by fastforce
            qed
            from wf_S[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] 
            obtain v w where u:"S = Fun (≐) [v, w]" and nv:"(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term v" and 
              nw:"(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term w" using un by auto
            have p:"?p = []"
            proof (rule ccontr)
              assume "¬ ?thesis"
              hence "v ⊵ (S |_ ?p) ∨ w ⊵ (S |_ ?p)" using pfun u by auto
                  (metis diff_Suc_1 fun_poss_imp_poss less_Suc0 less_Suc_eq nth_Cons' subt_at_imp_supteq)
              then show False using root_u nv nw 
                by (meson root_symbol_in_funas subset_eq supteq_imp_funas_term_subset)
            qed
            hence "replace_at S ?p (ω ∙ r) = (ω ∙ r)" by auto
            then show ?thesis using crhs_ω'rl wf_S[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] 
              by (simp add: wf_equational_term_def rule_pt.permute_prod.simps)
          qed
          then show ?thesis unfolding wf_equational_term_def using wf_eq_subst
            by (metis wf_equational_term_def)
        qed
        have vars_s1:"vars_term ?S1 ⊆ ?V" 
        proof -
          have *:"vars_term (ω ∙ r) ⊆ vars_term (ω ∙ l)" using wf[unfolded wf_trs_def] 
            by (metis fst_eqD local.wf rl rule_pt.fst_eqvt rule_pt.snd_eqvt snd_eqD sup.orderI vars_rule_def 
                vars_rule_eqvt vars_rule_lhs vars_term_eqvt)
          from var_cond_stable[OF this]
          have "vars_term ((ω ∙ r) ⋅ δ ) ⊆ vars_term ((ω ∙ l) ⋅ δ)" by fastforce
          from replace_var_stable[OF this]
          have "vars_term ?S1 ⊆ vars_term (replace_at S ?p ((ω ∙ l))⋅ δ)" 
            by (meson * replace_var_stable var_cond_stable)
          moreover have "vars_term ((replace_at S ?p (ω ∙ l))⋅ δ) = vars_term (S ⋅ δ)"
            by (metis ctxt_supt_id mgu_uv p subst_apply_term_ctxt_apply_distrib subst_apply_term_eq_subst_apply_term_if_mgu)
          moreover have "vars_term (S ⋅ δ) ⊆ ?V" 
            by (smt (verit) 1(8) Un_Diff Un_iff subsetI subset_Un_eq vars_term_subst_apply_term_subset)
          ultimately show ?thesis by auto
        qed
        have rel_chain':"⋀i. i < n - 1 ⟹ (f (i + 1), f (Suc i + 1)) ∈ rstep R" using rel_chain 
          by (simp add: 1(4))
        let ?f = "λi. f (i + 1)"
        have relstar:"(f 1, f n) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" using False 1(4) less_Suc_eq 
          by (induct n, blast, metis (no_types, lifting) One_nat_def rtrancl.simps)
        have "∃δ' θ' S'. narrowing_derivation_num ?S1 S' δ' (n - 1) ∧  f n = S' ⋅ θ' ∧ wf_equational_term S' ∧ normal_subst R θ' ∧
         (δ' ∘⇩s θ') |s ?V = ?θ1 |s ?V"
        proof (rule IH1[of "n - 1"  ?f "f 1" "f n" ?θ1 ?S1], goal_cases)
          case 1
          then show ?case using False by auto
        next
          case 2
          then show ?case by simp
        next
          case 3
          then show ?case using False by auto
        next
          case (4 i)
          then show ?case using rel_chain' by auto
        next
          case 5
          then show ?case using normθ1 by auto
        next
          case 6
          then show ?case using wf_S1 by auto
        next
          case 7
          have inempty:"subst_domain ?σr ∩ V = {}" using varempty' subinter by auto
          hence θsv:"(?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) |s V = θ |s V"
            using δ reseqδ reseqθ by auto
          have "(?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) |s (vars_term (ω ∙ r)) = ?σr |s (vars_term (ω ∙ r))" 
          proof -
            { fix v :: 'v
              have "vars_rule (ω ∙ (l, r)) - V = vars_rule (ω ∙ (l, r))" using varempty' by fastforce
              then have "V ∩ vars_term (ω ∙ r) = {}"  by (metis (no_types, lifting) disjoint_iff 
                    rule_pt.snd_eqvt snd_conv subsetD sup_ge2 varempty' vars_rule_def)
              then have "(?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) |s (vars_term (ω ∙ r)) = ?σr |s (vars_term (ω ∙ r))"
                by (smt (verit, best) Int_iff disjoint_iff inf.absorb_iff2 sub_θ subst_ext subst_union.simps)
            } then show ?thesis by fastforce
          qed
          have "f 1 = ?S1 ⋅ ?θ1"
          proof -
            have "f 1 = replace_at (S ⋅ θ) ?p ((ω ∙ r) ⋅ σr)" using crl f1 sθt 
              by (metis 1(2) ctxt_of_pos_term_hole_pos f0) 
            also have "...  = replace_at (S ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)) ?p ((ω ∙ r) ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr))" 
              by (metis 1(8) θsv coincidence_lemma' crl sndeq sup.boundedE)
            also have "... = replace_at S ?p (ω ∙ r) ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)" by (simp add: ctxt_of_pos_term_subst p)
            also have "... = replace_at S ?p (ω ∙ r) ⋅ (δ ∘⇩s (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr))" using δ by auto
            also have "... = ?S1 ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)" by simp
            also have *:"f 1 = ?S1 ⋅ ?θ1" using vars_s1 using calculation subst_apply_term_restrict_subst_domain by fastforce
            finally show ?thesis using * by fastforce
          qed
          then show ?case by auto
        next
          case 8
          then show ?case using vars_s1 subθ1 by auto
        next
          case 9
          then show ?case using relstar by blast
        next
          case 10
          then show ?case by (metis 1(10) finite_Diff2 infinite_Un mgu_finite_range_vars mgu_finite_subst_domain mgu_uv)
        qed
        then obtain δ' θ' S' where condn2:"narrowing_derivation_num ?S1 S' δ' (n - 1)" and subθ':"S'⋅ θ' = f n"
          and normθ':"normal_subst R θ'" and wfS':"wf_equational_term S'" and sub_rel:"(δ' ∘⇩s θ') |s ?V = ?θ1 |s ?V" by auto
        from n0_narrowing_derivation_num have n1:"n = 1 ⟹ S' = ?S1 ∧ δ' = Var" 
          using False using condn2 by (metis diff_self_eq_0)
        from condn2 obtain g τ where g0:"g 0 = ?S1" and gnm1:"g (n - 1) = S'"
          and gcond_chain:"∀i < n - 1. ((g i), (g (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ narrowing_step" and compδ':"if n = 1 then δ' = Var 
          else δ' = compose (map (λi. (τ i)) [0 ..< (n - 1)])" using False n1 unfolding narrowing_derivation_num_def by auto
        let ?g = "λi. if i = 0 then S else g (i - 1)"
        let ?τ = "λi. if i = 0 then δ else τ (i - 1)"
        have "δ' = compose (map ?τ [1..< n])" 
          by (smt (verit) One_nat_def compδ' add_diff_cancel_left' add_diff_inverse_nat compose_simps(1) diff_zero length_upt 
              less_Suc_eq_0_disj list.simps(8) map_equality_iff nth_upt plus_1_eq_Suc upt_eq_Nil_conv)      
        hence δδ'comp:"δ ∘⇩s δ' = compose (map ?τ [0..< n])" using False upt_conv_Cons by fastforce
        have condn:"narrowing_derivation_num S S' (δ ∘⇩s δ') n" 
        proof -
          have "(∃f. f 0 = S ∧ f n = S' ∧ (∃τ. (∀i<n. (f i, f (Suc i), τ i) ∈ narrowing_step) ∧
            δ ∘⇩s δ' = compose (map τ [0..<n])))" 
            by (rule exI[of _ ?g], insert δδ'comp False One_nat_def gnm1) (smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) Suc_pred gcond_chain 
                bot_nat_0.not_eq_extremum diff_Suc_1 g0 less_nat_zero_code nar not_less_eq)
          then show ?thesis 
            by (simp add: narrowing_derivation_num_def False local.wf)
        qed
        show ?thesis
        proof(rule exI[of _ "δ ∘⇩s δ'"], rule exI[of _ θ'], rule exI[of _ S'], intro conjI, goal_cases)
          case 1
          then show ?case using condn by auto
        next
          case 2
          then show ?case using 1(3) subθ' by auto
        next
          case 3
          then show ?case using normθ' using wfS' by auto
        next
          case 4
          then show ?case using wfS' normθ' by blast
        next
          case 5
          then show ?case 
            by (metis Un_upper1 r_subst_compose reseqθ sub_rel subst_monoid_mult.mult_assoc sup.orderE)
        qed
      qed
    qed
  qed
  then show ?thesis using narrowing_deriv_implication by blast
qed

end

end
